title: A preview's e2e run reports the commit the application answers at its declared version path
description: The delivery fixture's node application declares versionPath /api/meta/version and answers {"version": GRAPHYARD_PREVIEW_SHA} there, while its /healthz names no commit. A real preview of it runs its bound case and reports serving that commit, in the preview's detail, the run's report line and the recorded run; the same application without versionPath reports an unreported commit.

steps.name: a real preview of the fixture's node application reports the commit its versionPath answers
